# Safi Ghauri

> Safi Ghauri is a Dubai-based General Counsel to digital-asset and
> frontier-technology companies, a Barrister (called to the Bar of England &
> Wales at Lincoln's Inn) and a geopolitical analyst. He is Managing Partner of
> Esquare Legal, a UAE-licensed, Dubai-headquartered crypto-native law firm with
> teams in Brazil, Pakistan and China, and a Partner of Tahota Law Firm. He is a
> member of the European Commission/UNIDROIT Digital Assets Roundtable of
> Experts (DARTE). Based in Dubai; also works from São Paulo and Islamabad.

Key facts:
- General Counsel (fractional, direct appointments): InvoiceMate, Tharwa
  Finance, The Game Company, Klink Finance, M20 Chain, OpenSpace Africa;
  previously RWA Inc. (2024-2026). InvoiceMate and The Game Company are on the
  UAE Future 100 list
- Practice: fractional General Counsel; crypto and Web3 regulation; VARA,
  PVARA, BCB/CVM and MiCA licensing; stablecoins (including Shariah-certified
  structures); RWA tokenization; token launches; fundraising; cross-border
  capital structuring; disputes
- Qualified: called to the Bar of England & Wales (Lincoln's Inn, 2008);
  licensed to practise in the UAE, Pakistan and Brazil; LLM, City St George's;
  LLB (Hons), University of London
- Regulatory record: secured one of Dubai's earliest VARA VASP licences as Head
  of Legal & Compliance at Fasset; obtained Pakistan's first BNPL licence from
  the SECP (QisstPay, 2021); currently represents the world's second-largest
  crypto exchange and several leading fintechs before PVARA
- Transactions: USD 300 million tokenization mandate for Chinese new-energy
  mobility assets (RWA Inc., mandate value); $KLINK Tier-1 listings including
  Binance; $RWA KuCoin listing; Esquare acted for the Chinese investors in the
  USD 4.2 billion RUDA project (China Business Law Journal Deals of the Year
  2024)
- Litigation: Pakistan's largest defamation award (PKR 100 million against Tayyab Baloch of Bol TV, Additional District and Sessions Court Islamabad, 2022; lead
  counsel for Jang/Geo Group); a cryptocurrency matter won before the Supreme
  Court of India
- Media: quoted by The Independent (UK), Bloomberg Arabic (Asharq Business),
  CNA (Channel NewsAsia), Reuters, Gulf News, China Business Law Journal,
  TechRound, FinanceFeeds, ITWeb Africa
- Broadcast: 300+ broadcast appearances as a political and legal analyst,
  including as a regular contributor to Pakistan TV; officially appointed
  Pakistan TV South America Correspondent, reporting from São Paulo
- Speaking and policy: Horasis Global Summit, COP30, European Commission and
  UNIDROIT DARTE expert series, ETH LATAM, Stellar Meridian, Web3Experts
  Brazil; UNODC master trainer on crypto crime and terrorist financing; FATF
  digital-asset panel (2023)
- Profiled by Sunday magazine as "Pakistan's Most Prolific Tech Lawyer"
- Languages: English, Urdu, Punjabi (fluent); Portuguese (working); Chinese,
  German (basic)
- Also known as: Safi Ullah Ghauri, Safiullah Ghauri, Barrister Safi Ullah
  Ghauri, Barrister Safi Ghauri — all refer to the same person
